messages:
emma: Quick kickoff — Glasgow micro-region (edge) marketplace + dedicated SKU. EdgeFab confirmed racks in Glasgow colo. Need quotas, KMS/HSM plan, legal signoff, and joint announcement timeline. Target soft-launch May 18. Who can own the ops checklist?

raj: I can own infra quotas. First need exact GPU SKUs & counts from EdgeFab, and whether we need private VPC peering or marketplace NAT.

luis (EdgeFab): Confirmed: 3 racks initially, each rack = 4x A100S-80GB (total 12 GPUs). Hardware fallback: NVL-80 nodes on standby. We can expose HSM-backed KMS endpoints via partner VPC.

raj: Thanks — that's enough to start quota ticket. Proposed initial marketplace SKU name: `redwood.edge.glasgow.small` (12 GPUs). Anyone object?

ana: (typo) sorry meant ana: Legal: will need a Glasgow data-residency addendum + amended DPA. Also check export controls for hardware partner contract. Please route partner contact + draft SOW to legal@redwood.

emma: @ana noted. @luis can you share partner contract draft + KMS SLA? We need it for provisioning checklist.

luis (EdgeFab): Sharing draft contract v1 in DM. KMS SLA: 99.99% with key rotation window 72h. We can support HSM attestation.

sophie (NorthStar): NorthStar (SI) will handle cross-connects and private link setup. Need connector manifest + expected BGP/IP ranges. We'll validate cabling timeline vs rack install.

raj: I’ll open the quota & networking ticket now. Ticket body snippet:```
region: glasgow
requested_gpus: 12
node_type: a100s-80gb
network: vpc-peering OR private-link
marketplace_sku: redwood.edge.glasgow.small
launch_target: 2026-05-18
```

raj: Submitted ticket GLASGOW-QUOTA-1256 (https://internal.redwood/ops/tickets/GLASGOW-QUOTA-1256). Ping me for followups.

marketing: Hold joint announcement date May 20 (GA press) — need partner logos, legal-approved quote, and a 1-paragraph customer use-case by May 10. Also want a short co-authored blog with EdgeFab.

emma: Add quick ops checklist (first pass):
```
- Partner contract received 
- KMS/HSM endpoints validated
- Quota ticket approved
- Marketplace SKU created & entitlements set
- VPC peering / private link validated
- SI deployment runbook handed off
- Legal signoff + DPA addendum
- Marketing assets + quote ready
```

emma: @raj please flag any gating items. @ana ETA on legal review?

ana: (again typo) ana: I can turn around the addendum draft by 2026-04-28 if partner sends the contract + standard SOC reports.

luis (EdgeFab): Will upload SOC and contract by EOD. Also FYI EdgeFab can pre-provision KMS certs for faster onboarding if Redwood accepts partner CA.

raj: One more ops detail — we need to confirm image/quantization profile for the edge nodes. @eng-runtime: can we push a lightweight profile? (cc @emma)

partner-bot: Calendar event created: "Glasgow micro-region kickoffsync" Wed 2026-04-02 10:00 UTC — attendees: emma, raj, luis (EdgeFab), sophie (NorthStar), ana, marketing.

emma: Great — thanks all. I'll keep this thread for updates. Next steps: @luis upload docs, @raj file any followups on the ticket, @ana draft addendum, @marketing start asset list. :thumbsup:
